body.en: Nia Elasticity, Decibel Rhythm Boost and Activate

Nia has 2 Unique buffs, Elasticity and Decibel, both activated on Discard
Elasticity is a small Heal that is activated whenever any Ally Extra Attacks
Allies include Self
Decibel is a buff that makes every Ally Extra Attack after you Shuffle
Damage Scales per Decibel stack Nia has
Extra Attacks from Nia include Decibel, Mute Accent, G Chord, Soul Rip
The Extra Attack Damage scales off of the Character that performs it
Activate is the main Keyword of G Chord, it means to Play the Card for Free
Enemy turn count still decreases because a Card was Played
Rhythm Boost is the final Unique Buff, available after E2
It gives all Allies Additive Damage Increase
You get Rhythm Boost by Shuffling the Deck
Shuffles happen whenever you Draw from an empty Draw pile
Shuffles also happen if a card of the type you want to draw is in Discard
It will Shuffle your Discard in to gurantee you'll be able to Draw that card
"Move" Never Shuffles the deck

text.en: Draw 1. Discard up to 1 card(s). If a card was Discarded, create 1 Adagio with Exhaust.
Has a low chance for unexpected results to occur on use.

body.en:
Nia has very good card draw in Adagio 5
Because it Tutors for cards of a specific character
The only problem with that is, its not card positive
Example situation:
5 Card hand, you use Adagio 5
Adagio use + discard 1 = 3 cards, Adagio effect brings you back up to 5
Effectively you went +0 cards, sometimes this can be bad
Example 2:
2 Cards in hand, Adagio 5 + Good card
If you use the good card you're left with 1 card in hand
At that point Adagio 5 can no longer be used
This problem comes along with all of Nia's Adagio's some versions card negative
Adding Neutrals like Reorganize or Gearbag go card positive
Some characters also like having 10 cards in hand, Adagio is not good at that
